title: Chapter 497
paragraphs: Chapter 497
Episode 138. Keeper of the White Night Tower (3)
A storm-like sword strike scraped the protective shield of the spectral troops.
The spectral troops never thought Hedo would fight without considering them to this extent.
'Although we didn't expect Hedo to cooperate or perform a joint attack, this attitude is no different from treating us as enemies!'
Hedo, who smirked and swung his veil again, showed no intention of guaranteeing the safety of the spectral troops.
Beneath the black curtain spread by Murakan, lightning seemed to strike, and flashes of light sparkled. It was the light emitted by Joshua's black sword, Kainer.
Runcandel's 6th ultimate move, Lightning Flash.
It was already proven that ordinary attacks couldn't inflict damage on that immense body.
Unless it was a special attack like a minimum ultimate move, a tie, or a red sword strike gained from some enlightenment, it would rather become a vulnerability and backfire.
The aura condensed in Kainer exploded, scattering sharp fragments like shattered obsidian.
Thousands of fragments created intense noise, as if lightning erupted, and the dazzling light contained in each piece rapidly alternated between fading and brightening.
Eventually, Kainer rushed toward Hedo, leaving a myriad of changing trajectories. The irregularly dispersed sword strikes covered Hedo's figure like a scattered light reflection.
'I know the form of the ultimate move, Lightning Flash. Just like Barton Vichena did.'

As Jane thought while tracking Hedo's movement with her eyes, he had already experienced Runcandel's ultimate moves several times. Therefore, he adeptly predicted the path of the Lightning Flash and stepped accordingly.
Every time Hedo lifted his foot, the ground shook, and his ears felt stuffed. He wasn't just evading; he was also restraining the Runcandels with his energy.
Crack-!
As the Lightning Flash dissipated, Hedo's figure was revealed again.
Although he mostly evaded or deflected the ultimate move from the second-generation leader of the clan, his companions were no longer surprised by his unscathed appearance.

Everyone regained their composure. They were Runcandel's leaders and black knights. No matter how desperate the situation, those who stood at the forefront of swordsmanship always found a breakthrough.
Next was Diphus's sword.

The longsword Volgar, so long it seemed to reach the ceiling, fell from above. The 3rd ultimate move, Meteor Shower, featured countless sword strikes pouring down like a meteor shower, eroding Hedo's territory.
Hedo's body became blurry.
Not because it was obscured by the Meteor Shower like the Lightning Flash, but simply because he unbelievably escaped the point where the Meteor Shower was pouring down.
A speed that transcends sound.
A shockwave spread from where Hedo had stood, causing a sharp explosion. The next moment, Hedo was standing under Murakan's wing.
Right in front of Jane.
It felt as if a wall had suddenly appeared before her eyes.
Diphus had scattered Meteor Shower into the air but couldn't immediately retrieve his aura, making him a beat late to regain his stance. Jane couldn't keep up with Hedo's speed.
[Kid!]
Murakan tried to swoop down like a hawk to protect Jin, but Hedo had already raised his elongated sword towards Jin.
It was too late to dodge.
"That sword gives off a slightly dangerous vibe, 12th generation."
"Tsk!"

Although he managed to block it, Jin couldn't exert his full strength as he was concentrating his aura and magic power for the Demon Sword's ignition. It was as if Diphus couldn't recklessly reclaim the aura he used for Meteor Shower, there was a risk of backflow.
Even with the activation of the Aura Armor to mitigate the impact, clashing with Hedo and his sword caused searing pain throughout Jin's entire body.
The following strike was an upward slash as well. Jin twisted his body to the side to avoid the sword, and in the meantime, Murakan, who had rushed in, breathed a black mist onto Hedo's torso.
However, Hedo easily avoided the black breath. As a result, the breath went flying towards the Ghost Corps members behind Hedo.
One of them finally let out a curse, but it was drowned out by the explosive sound of things breaking and shattering all around the arena.
Clang...
Jin's mask split in half and fell to the ground.
Hedo's second upward slash wasn't intended to kill Jin but to remove his mask.
He briefly examined Jin's face and said, "You're quite handsome. I'm not sure if it's worth giving up your right arm for, though."
His words, "giving up your right arm," were muttered softly and barely audible, conveying a mix of emotions.
"What nonsense are you spouting during a fight?!"
Joshua shouted with anger in his eyes. He left afterimages as he charged towards Hedo, and his Black Sword Kainer had the aura ready for the 4th Ultimate Move, Falling Flowers.
He wasn't charging recklessly out of irritation from being ignored.
'We need to buy time...!'
He needed to buy time for the youngest to unfold the Demon Sword's ignition.
The slightly dangerous-feeling sword. Joshua was paying attention to what Hedo had just said.
If Jin could create a single opening with Ignition, he, along with the other Rune Knights and Murakan, could deal damage to Hedo.
Even if they couldn't finish him off, they could at least inflict injuries and secure an opportunity to escape.
'If that's still not enough, then considering using that power might be... necessary.'
Joshua was throwing himself at Hedo with such thoughts.
Diphus and Jane also rushed towards Hedo with similar intentions.
'Once the youngest unfolds Ignition, we'll go all out...!'
However, the Ghost Corps wasn't idle either. They hadn't experienced the power of Ignition, but they could clearly see what the Rune Knights were planning.
Kwaaaa-!

Murakan unleashed a barrage of breath and spirit thorns towards Hedo and the spectral squad. Thorns now sprouted not only from the ceiling but also from the ground, and the aura scattered in the air continued to be converted into decisive energy, pressuring Hedo.
Amid the dazzling lights of the rampant decisive energy, it was difficult to even discern each other's positions. Only Jin, protected by Murakan, was preparing for Upwha once again.
"But, something's strange."
While gathering magic and aura, Jin suddenly had a peculiar thought.
"If I were Hedo, I wouldn't fight like this."
Frustratingly enough.
Hedo had already created at least two opportunities to inflict fatal wounds on Jin. Maybe he could have even killed Jin.
"It feels like he's not being as aggressive as he should be. Why?"
Even now, Hedo could have easily penetrated the defense line.

It didn't seem like he was just enjoying the thrill of battle or savoring the fight itself. If that were the case, he would have fought more aggressively. If he worshipped the tension of life-and-death battles, Jin and his companions would have been inadequate opponents.
Actions are usually driven by a goal.
And if you know and can utilize the opponent's goal, the fight is bound to become easier.
"Is he trying to capture me alive and use me as a material for Masanseok? That doesn't make sense either. Is it just the whim of a powerful person?"
There was no time for deep contemplation. The siblings who had rushed at Hedo were constantly being repelled and getting back up.
Upwha was complete.
The blue light contained in the sword had grown deeper, and the shining rune letters, with the spirit armor deactivated, were igniting flames.
In an instant, Jin became fire.
The fire spread from him like a tidal wave, extending in all directions. Surprisingly, the blue light devoured the interior without touching his allies.
"Is this the achievement of the 12th generation? Is this the power that single-handedly destroyed the Sword Garden...?"
The spectral squad immediately ceased their attack and focused all their power on defense. Even in their best condition, the four members of the spectral squad could not fully block Jin's Upwha.
They had to avoid it. However, there was nowhere to retreat, with dead-end walls on all sides, and the other Rune Kendels and Murakan were launching their offense as well.
"If Hedo doesn't help, they'll all suffer fatal injuries that will make further combat impossible, or die!"
The spectral squad had already been under considerable physical strain due to the battle with Joshua and his companions before Hedo arrived.
Moreover, they were simultaneously dealing with the attacks of the Rune Kendels and Hedo, so even if they were the spectral squad, survival became a problem.
"Remarkable."
As he pushed back the encroaching blue light, Hedo expressed admiration for the first time.
Compared to the other generations and the black knight's sword he knew, the Rune Kendels seemed inferior, and Murakan's rumored martial prowess had so far been below expectations.
On the other hand, Jin's magic sword technique seemed to contain something dazzling even to Hedo's eyes.
However, Hedo could intuitively tell. Jin's magic sword was not yet complete.
"Well, if he continues to grow well like this, he'll be able to handle our outrageous lady. Of course, this is assuming she's not a Jifle and the 12th generation isn't Rune Kendel."
Hedo suddenly felt bitter.
Sandra's love would never bear fruit. After all, Jin and his family were no different from patients with a terminal diagnosis. Perhaps.
Hedo thought that it might be better to end Jin's life now. It might be better for the lady to let Jin die honorably in a fight like this, rather than becoming a material for Masanseok.
What should he do?
As his mind began to feel tangled, the cries of the spectral squad irritated Hedo's nerves.
"Hedo! Are you just going to stand by and watch?"
Hedo never intended to help them from the beginning.
They all had to be left to die to serve as a proper warning to Octavia Jifle.
"Why are you calling me? You should beg for your life from the enemy... Huh!"
Aaaaah!
Jin, who had suddenly rushed in, thrust his sword towards Hedo's face.
"Tower keeper of Baekya, you are a warrior who should show respect even to your enemies. But you seem too idle."
Although it was blocked, the flames of Upwha climbed up the longsword's veil and transferred onto Hedo's body like oil.
In an instant, his upper body was covered in blue fire, but Hedo looked down at Jin without any sign of pain.
At a glance, it seemed as if Hedo was not affected by the blue fire, but Jin didn't feel discouraged.
The power of Upwha and the strength of Rune Kendel were not all there was.
"12th generation, I have a suggestion for you."
"A suggestion?"
"Leave behind anything you've taken from this place. If you do, I'll spare your life for now."
What they took from here.
The meaning was clear without having to think about it.
It was the blueprint of the spaceship.
'What is he talking about all of a sudden? The blueprint is already stolen?'
As he tried to choose a response while suppressing his absurd thoughts, something fell to the ground from within the flames of Upwha that enveloped Jin.
It was the key he received from Joshua.
For a moment, Hedo's words were blocked, and he could only stare at the fallen key with wide eyes.
